# My Town Tourism Website

## Description
This project is a tourism website that presents information about my town, including its history, attractions, and location.

## Pages
- Home page: General information and map
- History page: Background of the town
- Visit page: Places to visit and activities

## Design
The website uses HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap. A 7:5 layout was used on the visit page.

## Navigation
A navigation bar is included to move between pages.

## Challenges
Some challenges included resizing images, fixing layout issues, and integrating the map.
